name: Polycam
tagline: Polycam is a mobile and web app that captures real-world objects and spaces in 3D using a smartphone camera or LiDAR sensor. Its AI processing converts photos into accurate 3D models exportable to GLTF, OBJ, and CAD formats. Architects, game developers, and e-commerce brands use it to digitise physical objects.
